# History Walk

> History Walk is a choose-your-own-path history scenario for Athenian students. A student plays a person escaping
> slavery, makes each slide's decision, and explains it in at least five words; teachers follow their class's progress
> and reasons. It is a Kotlin Multiplatform app: a Ktor server and a KVision single-page client talking over Kilua RPC,
> with Postgres behind Exposed and Flyway, and Google sign-in for the school's accounts.

Facts that are easy to get wrong:

- One deployment serves one walk. `SLIDES_VARIABLE_NAME` is `jermain` (the default) or `moses`; any other value stops
  the server. The decks are Kotlin values compiled into the jar, not data.
- The role comes from the Google account's address: in `TEACHER_EMAILS` means teacher; a local part starting with two
  digits (`27msmith@athenian.org`) means student; anyone else is refused. Only `athenian.org` accounts sign in.
- A slide's identity is its path name, the chain of titles from the first slide (`/Introduction/1st Decision`).
  Progress is stored by path name, so renaming or moving a slide strands students on it; `SlidePathsTest` pins every
  path name to a snapshot.
- Moves are validated on the server against the deck; the client's titles and flags are ignored.
- Teachers' walks are left out of the class pages, except moves made while the admin page's "Teachers see student
  view" switch is on (`history.settings`, `user_choices.counted_as_student`).
- `OAUTH_CALLBACK_URL` must be `https` for a deployed server; `http` only works for `localhost`.
- `V001` begins with `drop schema if exists history cascade`; `Dbms.migrate` refuses to run it on a database whose
  `history` tables survived without `public.flyway_schema_history`. Never edit an applied migration.
- The database driver is the PostgreSQL JDBC driver (pgjdbc). The server refuses a `DBMS_URL` that doesn't start with
  `jdbc:postgresql:`, such as one still written for pgjdbc-ng (`jdbc:pgsql:`), which it used through 1.1.3.
- A platform's `DATABASE_URL` (Railway's `${{Postgres.DATABASE_URL}}`) wins over `DBMS_URL`/`DBMS_USERNAME`/
  `DBMS_PASSWORD`; `DBMS_NAME` names the database on that server in place of the URL's, and `DBMS_QUERY_PATH` the query
  string. `ContainerDatabaseUrl` parses it, passes the query string to pgjdbc, and logs only `host:port/db as user`.
- The connection is unencrypted unless the URL sets `sslmode` (`Dbms.unencryptedUnlessAsked` overrides pgjdbc's
  `prefer`), which suits a platform's private network.
- A deployment starts the jar with its own start command, `java -jar build/libs/history-walk.jar -port=$PORT`; there is
  no Procfile.
- Releases: `make release-check` lists what stops one; `make release` runs every gate, pushes the image to Docker Hub,
  and creates the GitHub release (tag `X.Y.Z`, title `vX.Y.Z`, notes from `RELEASE_NOTES.md`).
- KSP is held at 2.3.12 (google/ksp#3286).

## Docs

- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/index.md): what History Walk is, the two walks, and where to start
- [Teacher guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/teachers/index.md): what teachers can do, and a first session step by step
- [Signing in](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/teachers/signing-in.md): Google sign-in, its messages, session length, sign-out
- [The walk](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/teachers/the-walk.md): slides, choices, reasons, dead ends, going back, the update dialog
- [Your teacher view](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/teachers/teacher-view.md): the teacher's header links, test walks, slide jumping
- [Class summary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/teachers/class-summary.md): the `/summary` page's columns and order
- [Student reasons](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/teachers/student-reasons.md): the `/reasons` page
- [Trying the walk as a student](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/teachers/student-view.md): the admin page's switch and the clear of teachers' walks
- [Teacher questions and answers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/teachers/faq.md): sign-in, walk, and class-page problems
- [Administrator guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/admins/index.md): the architecture and common tasks
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/admins/configuration.md): every environment variable and its default
- [Google sign-in](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/admins/google-sign-in.md): the OAuth client, redirect URIs, and `redirect_uri_mismatch`
- [Teachers and students](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/admins/access.md): the role rule and the teacher list
- [Deployment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/admins/deployment.md): building from the repository, Railway, and Docker
- [Database](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/admins/database.md): schema, migrations, the startup guard, backups, and queries
- [Releases and updates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/admins/releases.md): `version` and `apiVersion`, the update check, and Cloudflare caching
- [Slide decks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/admins/slide-decks.md): the deck DSL and path names
- [Monitoring and troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/admins/troubleshooting.md): health checks, log lines, and startup and build errors
- [Development](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/website/history-walk/docs/admins/development.md): local setup, tests, and CI

## Code

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/AGENTS.md): the detailed guide to the code: commands, architecture, sign-in, caching, version check, tests, and gotchas
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/README.md): environment variables, Google Cloud setup, and Gradle tasks
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each release
- [RELEASE_NOTES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/RELEASE_NOTES.md): each release for teachers and administrators, with upgrade steps
- [Services.kt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/pambrose/historywalk/Services.kt): `IContentService`, the whole client/server RPC interface
- [ServiceImpl.kt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/src/jvmMain/kotlin/com/pambrose/historywalk/ServiceImpl.kt): the RPC service, which validates every move against the deck
- [Routes.kt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/src/jvmMain/kotlin/com/pambrose/historywalk/Routes.kt): the access map: which routes need a session or a teacher
- [Pages.kt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/src/jvmMain/kotlin/com/pambrose/historywalk/Pages.kt): the server-rendered teacher pages
- [MainPanel.kt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/src/jsMain/kotlin/com/pambrose/historywalk/MainPanel.kt): the walk page in the browser
- [Makefile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pambrose/history-walk/master/Makefile): every development, test, Docker, release, and docs command (`make` lists them)
